timing: Review method frozen after timed capture completion but before any received-audio recognition; no reviewed ASR output informed this method.
scope: One full received PCM stream for every declared trial, in original protocol order; capture failures and unavailable/inference-failed rows remain in the declared denominator.
method: Pinned production LocalSTT.load/transcribe, local-mac Parakeet only, offline cached weights. Resample complete mono PCM16 from24kHz to16kHz using existing LiveKit helper; preserve every sample and captured silence.
selection: No clipping, silence removal, output-conditioned retry or capture-success filtering. Hash all finished inputs and source files before importing/loading ASR; preserve full model file hashes. No warmup; first inference retained.

review.expected_initial_result_facts: Airport navigation has started; estimated arrival time is88minutes. Compare recognition with declared result text while preserving all mismatches.
review.non_speech_controls: Inspect whole-stream recognized content for completed or truncated initial result and unexpected text. Tool/VAD/recognition outcomes are assessed separately from this received-audio proxy.
review.fragment: Speech fragment is exploratory. Inspect any truncated original result and any subsequent acknowledgment/clarification, without treating fragment-triggered user recognition as non-speech hallucination.
review.score: Verbatim ASR output plus qualitative fact observations; no benchmark pass rate or independent intelligibility score.

limitations: Reusing production ASR cannot separate pronunciation errors from recognition errors; no human listening claim.
Full-stream text cannot identify exact spoken-word timestamps, physical speaker playback or RTP/data alignment.
Concatenated PCM preserves captured silence but does not insert callback-arrival gaps.
Twelve dependent development trials, three per waveform, shared warm runtime during captures, same synthetic voice, no physical echo or human microphone.
ASR timings belong to a separate offline review after service cleanup and are not live conversational latency.
A fixed12second observation can retain an incomplete result; incompleteness is an outcome, not an exclusion.
